text: You received two tablets and you only need one. You want to return the more expensive one and refund to credit card. If refund to credit card is not possible, you become angry and return everything on that order and refund to GC.
zh: 您收到了两部平板电脑，但您只需要一部。您想退掉更贵的那部，并要求退款到信用卡。如果无法退款到信用卡，您会生气并退掉该订单的所有商品，并要求退款到礼品卡。
